title: Zodiac Warrior
description: A vibrant fantasy scene shows a female warrior with pink and blue hair in ornate bronze armor, dual-wielding glowing pink curved blades in a dynamic stance. Behind her stands a spectral armored figure while a large ethereal female profile with multicolored flowing hair overlooks a cosmic background filled with zodiac symbols, constellations, bubbles, and swirling nebulae.
prompt: A dynamic fantasy painting featuring a female warrior with vibrant pink and blue hair wearing detailed bronze armor, dual wielding glowing pink curved swords in combat stance.
